definitions.carbineers: Mounted gunpowder units with primary range greater than the 60-range pistol baseline.
definitions.light_artillery: Siege-category unit with nominal crew strength <=10.
definitions.heavy_artillery: Siege-category unit with nominal crew strength >10.
definitions.melee_auxiliaries: Infantry whose primary attack is not missile.
